Ollama v0.9.6 runtime notices

Binary build: Go go1.24.5, darwin/arm64, CGO enabled.
Source revision: 43107b15b9bcff51ef1c5391c273fd1a747f6d0a

The go/ folder contains the original LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING texts from the
47 exact dependency modules listed in the bundled executable. inventory.json
records pinned Go module-proxy URLs and notice paths. Included Go runtime,
llama.cpp and ggml notices come from their matching upstream source revisions.
License copies retain their upstream terms; they are not relicensed under
Local Dictation's MIT license.
